definitions.explanation: A situation in which one good result produces the conditions for the next, so improvement feeds on itself. Standard vocabulary in economic and business commentary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{好|こう}{循環|じゅんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: A virtuous cycle has emerged in the economy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賃上|ちんあ}げ→賃上げ：14256_chinage⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{好|こう}{循環|じゅんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: We are aiming for a virtuous cycle of wage increases and consumption.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満足度|まんぞくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がれば→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{好|こう}{循環|じゅんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: We have entered a virtuous cycle in which higher employee satisfaction raises the quality of service.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好|こう}{循環|じゅんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}む→生む：29531_umu⟧: to create a virtuous cycle
- {好|こう}{循環|じゅんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter a virtuous cycle
- {好|こう}{循環|じゅんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}り→回る：01150_mawaru⟧{始|はじ}める: for the cycle to start turning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪|あく}{循環|じゅんかん}→悪循環：12668_akujunkan⟧: vicious cycle — the far more frequently used of the pair, and the word to learn first.

USAGE:
Mostly written and formal: economics reporting, policy statements, and business planning. In casual speech people describe the same idea with ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧ (a good run of things).
